REQ-NAV-001 against the real stack › REQ-NAV-001 AC-7 the home link on the not-found page is reachable and operable by keyboard with visible focus
NFR-002 AC-1 sign up, log in, add, edit, complete and delete send every browser request to localhost only
NFR-003 AC-1 with 500 to-dos, list, filter, search, page, create, edit, complete and delete each show their result within 1 second at the 95th percentile
NFR-006 AC-1 with the list request aborted, the list screen shows a friendly message with its next step; after the interception is removed, trying again loads the list
NFR-006 AC-2 a 500 problem response with internals in its body shows none of them to the user
REQ-LIST-003 AC-6 a page number past the last in the URL shows the last valid page without an error
REQ-LIST-001 AC-5 an unknown status in the URL is removed and the list shows All
REQ-TODO-003 AC-2 a user with no to-dos sees the first-use empty state
